_comment: Cache-safe temporal E2E (openai). Two-run cross-turn pattern with >=3s gap so the volatile temporal suffix DIFFERS between turns, while the stable system prefix stays cacheable. Expect run1 cache_write>0, run2 cache_read>0. Run: `set -a; source .env; set +a; unset ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; SESS=tmp_openai_$(date +%s); ./target/release/dag_engine run tests/graphs/agents/provider_cache_temporal_openai_e2e.json --agent-session-id $SESS --include-extra-info; sleep 3; ./target/release/dag_engine run tests/graphs/agents/provider_cache_temporal_openai_e2e.json --agent-session-id $SESS --include-extra-info`

config.system_message: You are a deterministic cache-test agent. Reply with EXACTLY one line: 'cache_test_done'. STABLE filler forming the cacheable prefix follows; ignore it. Colmena is a Rust-native AI agent orchestration library with a hexagonal architecture spanning domain, application, and infrastructure layers, and it supports OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini providers behind a single LlmRepository trait. The DAG engine wires nodes declared in JSON; each node implements ExecutableNode and emits outputs under the output convention. Built-in nodes include sql_query, http_request, python_script, image_generation, image_edit, tts, suspend, secure_suspend, trigger_webhook, router, output_parser, subgraph, and the orchestrator. Synthetic tools include the gsheets and gdocs families, sql_inspect_attachment, sql_bulk_insert_from_attachment, attachment_run_python, load_attachment, load_skill, and describe_tool. Attachments flow through the OutputStorageRepository port and persist uniformly at registration. Skills load on demand via include_dir with YAML frontmatter. Lazy tool loading reveals schemas progressively through describe_tool. Conversational memory persists across sessions in Postgres keyed by agent_session_id. Secure values are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. The orchestrator coordinates a planner, an executor, a critic loop, and bridge tasks; subgraph nodes nest and HITL suspension propagates upward. RAG uses pgvector. Streaming SSE carries node-start, node-end, and finish events. Prompt caching cuts repeat-prefix cost on all three providers. The workspace depends on sqlx, tokio, reqwest, schemars, serde, anyhow, thiserror, pyo3, and napi-rs. The python sandbox validates code through an AST check. The gsheets node speaks the Google Sheets REST API; the gdocs node speaks the Google Docs API plus Drive. SQL bulk insert streams CSV into Postgres via COPY FROM STDIN.
